topic: Inspection of neutron radiography introduction, different methods principle and various applications
syllabus_extract: Inspection of neutron radiography introduction, different methods principle and various applications
specific_objectives: 16.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to explain the principle of radiographic NDT.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of radiographic NDT principles using PPT slides; Instructor supervision of trainee note-taking and Q&A session.
intro_questions: What is the primary difference between X-ray and neutron radiography?
Name one material that is difficult to inspect using X-rays but easy with neutrons.

development.content:
Introduction to Neutron Radiography
Principle of Radiographic NDT
Interaction of Neutrons with Matter
Neutron Source Types and Selection
Image Formation and Detection Methods

Different Methods of Neutron Radiography
Transmission vs. Backscatter Techniques
Fission vs. Radioisotope Sources
Digital vs. Film Detection Systems
Safety Precautions for Neutron Fields

Various Applications in Aerospace
Inspection of Composite Materials
Detection of Hydrogenous Defects
Corrosion Assessment in Reactors
Limitations and Future Trends

summary_questions: Explain how the principle of radiographic NDT applies to neutron imaging.
Describe one specific application of neutron radiography in aircraft maintenance.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the advantages of neutron radiography over ultrasonic inspection for detecting defects in hydrogen-rich composite structures, referencing concepts from LP 02.
